lineage.strategy: Acquire current issuer-reported operating evidence with segment, cash-flow and guidance detail rather than repeat broad automation-theme evidence.

observations.fact: Rockwell reported fiscal Q3 2026 sales of $2.313B, up 8% year over year, with organic sales up 10%; Software & Control sales rose 19% and organic ARR rose 6%, while quarterly free cash flow was $654M versus $489M a year earlier.

Rockwell raised fiscal-2026 reported and organic sales-growth guidance to 7.5%-9.5% and adjusted EPS guidance to $13.00-$13.30; management cited semiconductor, data-center and warehouse automation strength plus improving automotive and life-sciences activity.

risks.risk: Lifecycle Services sales fell 12% reported and 2% organically, and management identified negative price/cost as a partial margin offset; headline enterprise growth is therefore not uniform across segments.

unknowns.unknown: The release does not isolate backlog conversion, customer concentration, or incremental returns on data-center/semiconductor automation investment by end market.

recommendation: Use Q3 reported sales, ARR, segment margin, free-cash-flow and updated guidance as current source-addressed operating inputs. Alpha retains numeric scoring and valuation authority.
